recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed unless a new Security WG issue reopens typed network address metadata or changes the string encoding rule.
issue_request: FHIR-39116 asked to bring back R4 AuditEvent.agent.network.type so a client network value could indicate that networkString carries an IP address. Its Published / Not Persuasive with Modification resolution instead clarified AuditEvent.agent.network[x] requirements: prefer Reference(Endpoint) or URI, use string only when address or hostname is all that is known, and encode strings as canonical host names or literal numeric addresses in square brackets.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by commit a3adca8e6f9921c9bdca3288f8f39b1455794b96, which changed source/auditevent/structuredefinition-AuditEvent.xml requirements text for AuditEvent.agent.network[x] to the current resolution wording.
additional_context: AuditEvent is active in source/fhir.ini, and fhir.ini maps the removed R4 AuditEvent.agent.network.address and AuditEvent.agent.network.type paths to network[x]. The originating Zulip discussion and Security WG minutes support string encoding guidance rather than restoring network.type.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current AuditEvent.agent.network[x] already permits Reference(Endpoint), uri, and string, and its requirements text contains the accepted canonical-hostname and literal-address guidance.
